course_description: Comprehensive study of Knowledge Discovery in Databases (KDD), data preprocessing, association rule mining (Apriori, FP-Growth), classification algorithms (Decision Trees, Naive Bayes, Random Forests), clustering (K-Means, DBSCAN), and Python data mining pipelines with scikit-learn.
